title: UniTraffic-Agent: Unified Traffic Video Reasoning for AI City Challenge 2026 Track 3 with Two Out-of-Domain Evaluations
abstract: arXiv:2608.13031v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Traffic video understanding has become an important problem in intelligent transportation, as road videos provide direct evidence for accidents, violations, and interactions between vehicles and vulnerable road users. A useful system should explain how a traffic event develops, why it happens, and when the relevant interaction occurs, yet this remains difficult for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) because traffic videos contain sparse events and varied viewpoints. translated_title: UniTraffic-Agent：面向AI城市挑战赛2026赛道3的统一交通视频推理与两项域外评估
translated_abstract: 交通视频理解已成为智能交通中的重要问题，因为道路视频为事故、违规行为以及车辆与弱势道路使用者之间的交互提供了直接证据。一个实用的系统应能解释交通事件如何发展、为何发生以及相关交互何时出现，然而这对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）而言仍具挑战性，因为交通视频包含稀疏事件和多种视角。我们介绍了UniTraffic-Agent，这是第十届AI城市挑战赛赛道3的MR-CAS解决方案，涵盖交通异常推理（TAR）和两项域外评估：用于鱼眼交通事件的FETV和用于行人意图推理的PSI-VQA。UniTraffic-Agent遵循“观察—推理—行动—验证”的工作流程，采样带时间戳的视觉证据，在单次请求中推理同一片段的所有问题，并通过特定任务的适配器转换响应。
tldr: UniTraffic-Agent通过“观察—推理—行动—验证”的统一流程和单次多问题推理，有效处理稀疏交通事件与多视角，并在域外评估中实现稳健的交通视频推理。
en_tdlr: UniTraffic-Agent handles sparse traffic events and varied viewpoints through an observe-reason-act-verify unified workflow with single-request multi-question reasoning, achieving robust traffic video reasoning in out-of-domain evaluations.
